name: Adventure & Action
description: Explore thrilling and high-energy experiences. This category includes activities like bungee jumping, skydiving, whitewater rafting, rock climbing, off-road driving, and challenging outdoor pursuits designed to get your adrenaline pumping.

name: Airborne Experiences
description: Discover activities that take you to the skies. Find options such as scenic helicopter tours, hot air balloon rides, paragliding, gliding, and introductory flying lessons.

name: Automotive & Motor Sports
description: Immerse yourself in the world of vehicles and speed. This category offers supercar driving experiences, track days, go-karting, rally driving, and off-road vehicle adventures.

name: Beauty & Wellness
description: Indulge in relaxation and rejuvenation. This category features a range of spa treatments, massages, beauty salon services, aesthetic procedures, and wellness retreats focused on physical and mental well-being.

name: Creative & Learning
description: Unleash your inner artist or learn a new skill. Explore workshops for painting, pottery, photography, crafting, music, dance, writing, and other hands-on, educational, or expressive activities.

name: Cultural & Entertainment
description: Engage with arts, history, and live performances. This category includes tickets to theatre shows, concerts, musicals, comedy acts, museum entries, historical tours, and cultural events.

name: Culinary & Dining
description: Savor unique gastronomic delights. Find cooking classes, wine tasting tours, gourmet dining experiences, food tours, distillery visits, and special themed meals.

name: Nature & Wildlife Encounters
description: Connect with the natural world and its inhabitants. This category offers experiences like animal encounters (e.g., farm visits, wildlife sanctuaries), guided nature walks, birdwatching, and eco-tours.

name: Photography Experiences
description: Capture lasting memories with professional guidance. Discover professional photoshoots for portraits, families, special occasions, or guided photography tours to iconic locations.

name: Short Breaks & Getaways
description: Plan your next escape with curated accommodation and leisure packages. This category includes romantic retreats, city breaks, countryside stays, wellness getaways, and themed short vacations.

name: Tours & Sightseeing
description: Explore destinations with expert guidance. Find guided city tours, historical tours, bus tours, walking tours, cycling tours, and excursions to famous landmarks or hidden gems.

name: Water Sports & Aquatic Adventures
description: Dive into fun and adventure on or in the water. This category features activities like scuba diving, snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking, jet skiing, sailing, and boat trips.
